message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "override_classifier_dismissal_for_solitary_nodule", "description": "When a chest X-ray classifier returns low confidence scores for all categories but visual inspection identifies a solitary, well-circumscribed nodule, do not dismiss the finding as normal.", "applicable_conditions": "Applies to differential diagnosis tasks involving chest imaging where automated classification tools yield negative or inconclusive results despite the presence of distinct morphological features (e.g., nodules, masses) visible on manual review.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns low scores for all categories (indicating no strong findings) BUT visual inspection reveals a solitary, well-circumscribed nodule: (1) Do NOT accept the 'normal' or 'negative' classification; (2) Prioritize direct visual morphology analysis (assessing border smoothness, calcification, and consolidation); (3) Integrate clinical context to differentiate between vascular anomalies (e.g., PAVM), malignancy, or infection, recognizing that standard classifiers may miss rare vascular malformations."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
